preconditions.description: The number of vertices n and queries q are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ai <= n for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each vertex value ai is a non-negative integer not exceeding n.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: The tree has exactly n-1 edges, and each edge connects two vertices within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query consists of two vertices u and v within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: is_ancestor(u, v) for u, v in queries
preconditions.description: For each query (u, v), u is an ancestor of v (including u = v).

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one line per query.
Each output line is a valid integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(output_lines[i]) <= n for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: Each output integer is within the valid range of vertex values.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == max(a[i] ^ dist(i, v) for i in path(u, v)) for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: For each query (u, v), the output is the maximum value of (ai XOR dist(i, v)) for all vertices i on the path from u to v (inclusive).
